soundtrack.music: Polished modern tech keynote music for a product reveal: a confident electronic pulse, warm analog synth pads, punchy but restrained drums and a sleek bass line; an uplifting chord lift each time a new tool appears. Energetic yet sophisticated and premium, like a big smartphone launch event. Around 116 BPM, clear space for a voice-over. Ends with a clean, satisfying final hit. No vocals.
